dogecoin.text: The intention of creators of $Shib was to dethrone Dogecoin & after the SHIB price skyrocketed, it reached a valuation of $26B very close to dogecoin ( $30B) .
Dogecoin was built by engineers around the meme of shiba Inu a Japanese breed of dog. The popularity of dogecoin in the recent times led to creation of new meme coins among which one was Shiba Inu.
How a meme coin made to poke fun of DogeCoin achieved a market cap of $22B 🐶
